messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Memory pressure on hosted-runtime kvcache nodes (us-west-2). Rapid growth in KV entries observed, >5x baseline in 7m. Potential OOM risk. Paging oncall.
alex: oncall-ops, i got the page. seeing huge kv_map growth correlated with a batch spike around 17:12 UTC.
oncall-ops: acknowledged — jumping in. can you dump top keys patterns? suspect long-prompt sessions causing runaway context.
alex: grabbing sample logs now. looks like a handful of sessions with repeated long prompts + streaming turned on, prefix lengths 60k-120k tokens. continuous-batching kept aggregating.
sam: hmm continuous batching policy should cap session input size. is prefetch enabled for hosted? that'd amplify KV entries.
priya: prefetch is enabled by default for the recent rollout (config v2.4.1). there's a new heuristic that prefetches KV for predicted next tokens; probably misfired for really long contexts.
morgan: attaching a quick heap snapshot snippet (truncated):
```
KVMap size: 12,384,672 entries
Top key prefix: session:chat:usr_9a*
Estimated mem: 1.9 TB
Evictions/sec: 0.2
```
eng-runtime: confirmed prefetch behavior: it stores KV slices per batch window; for long prompts we keep growing sliding windows without eviction because pagewalk thresholds weren't hit.
oncall-ops: immediate mitigation options?
alex: can we disable prefetch for sessions > 30k tokens via runtime flag? that should stop new growth.
priya: yes we have feature flag runtime.disable_prefetch_long_sessions. flipable via console; can ship a hotpatch to toggle for hosted.
sam: also reduce batching.window_ms from 20ms to 5ms as temporary so we stop continuous aggregation across many tokens.
oncall-ops: plan: 1) flip disable_prefetch_long_sessions ON 2) set batching.window_ms=5ms in the hosted pool 3) trigger evict sweep on affected kv shards 4) monitor memory graphs for 15m. anyone object?
morgan: +1. will prepare evict job. caution: evict sweep can spike CPU, but acceptable.
cs-rep: we have 3 customers showing tail latency errors; CS needs templated comms. impact likely 5-10% requests returning 5xx due to OOM retries.\neng-runtime: implementing toggle now. pushing flag update to the control plane, will propagate to hosted-runtime pools.
alex: posting commands used:
```
# flip feature
redwoodctl runtime-feature set disable_prefetch_long_sessions true --env hosted --pool us-west-2
# adjust batching window
redwoodctl runtime-config set batching.window_ms 5 --env hosted --pool us-west-2
# trigger evict
redwoodctl kvcache evict --shard affected-03 --threshold 0.6
```
oncall-ops: flag change done. batching window change in progress (rolling across 6 nodes).
eng-runtime: evict sweep queued. watch mem metrics.
alex: memory graph starting to flatten at 17:22 UTC. KVMap size dropping from 12.3M -> 3.1M over 4 min.
sam: good. watch for regression when sessions close; we should also patch logic to not prefetch for streaming sessions with >1e4 tokens predicted.
priya: creating an issue: RUNTIME-1219 "prefetch heuristic runaway for long/streaming contexts". assigning to eng-runtime.
oncall-ops: are we confident this removes immediate OOM risk? any fallback if evict doesn't keep up?
morgan: fallback: enable per-session kv cap (max_entries_per_session=1024) as last resort. That'll drop context for huge sessions — bad for customers but prevents node crash.
cs-rep: please give CS a one-paragraph summary we can send to affected customers. need ETA on full resolution.
eng-runtime: summary draft: "We observed a memory spike tied to an interaction pattern with extremely long prompts and the new prefetch heuristic. We rolled back the heuristic and applied temporary batching and eviction changes; hosts are stabilizing. We're working on a code fix to avoid prefetching for very long/streaming sessions and will follow up with patches and postmortem."
alex: rolling postmortem timeline: immediate mitigation applied 17:18 UTC, memory plateau 17:22 UTC, stable 17:30 UTC. long-term fix ETA by end of next sprint (2w).
oncall-ops: i've notified pager duty follow-up oncall for weekday mornings to monitor.
cs-rep: sent comms to 3 impacted customers at 17:45 UTC with the summary. flagged for follow-up.
sam: follow-up work: add unit tests for prefetch heuristics, add telemetry to flag token-count vs prefetched-slices ratio, add circuit-breaker when kv_map growth rate > X per minute.
priya: making the toggle permanent until we ship patch. I'll coordinate canary with eng-runtime.
alex: ok closing the live thread. please append any extra notes. :thumbsup:
oncall-ops: incident resolved (stabilized) — closing oncall handoff. will file a concise postmortem and link to RUNTIME-1219.
morgan: note for postmortem: consider expiring streaming KV entries more aggressively and backpressure for clients sending huge continuous prompts.
eng-runtime: will include logs, commands, and heap snapshots in the postmortem. assigning to priya/sam for remediation.
cs-rep: leaving thread — ping if we need a revised customer update.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: status -> resolved (mitigated)."
